description: IKEA recalled its BUSA children's folding tent sold in August and September 2011. The steel wire frame can break and is a laceration and puncture hazard.
shortAnswer: IKEA has recalled a children's folding tent it sold in August and September of 2011. The steel wire frame of the BUSA children's folding tent is defective and can break, producing sharp wire ends that can protrude through the tent fabric and injure a child.

faq.q: How can I tell if my child's tent is the recalled IKEA BUSA tent?
faq.a: The brand names IKEA and BUSA and the model number (90192009) are printed on a label sewn into an interior seam in the tent. IKEA sold about 58,000 of the tents in the United States and Canada.
